entities.summary: Vladimir Alekseyevich Alftan Russian: Владимир Алексеевич Альфтан; 29 April [O.S. 17 April] 1860 – 19 December 1940) was a lieutenant general of the Imperial Russian Army, military orientalist, and researcher of Korea.
